zh: 修复含有大型对象的 Word 长文档在侧栏长时间只显示第一条公式的问题。目录分段在后台压缩并按顺序送达，全文核验期间可继续显示并搜索已收到的公式。
en: Fixed a case where the sidebar showed only the first equation for an extended time in long Word documents with large embedded objects. Preview batches are compressed in the background and delivered in order so received equations remain visible and searchable during full-document verification.
